# Avinash Bhor Photo Studio

> Avinash Bhor Photo Studio is a professional photography studio in Mumbai, India, run by photographer Avinash Bhor. It shoots weddings, pre-wedding stories, engagements, fashion, maternity, baby and portrait sessions, and is available worldwide for destination shoots. The site is available in English, Hindi and Marathi.

## Services and pricing

Prices are starting points in Indian rupees (INR). Travel and stay for destination shoots are quoted separately.

- Wedding Day, from ₹35,000: full-day coverage of the ceremony and everything on either side of it. Up to 12 hours with two photographers, 200+ hand-edited photographs, a private online gallery for family (Google Drive), album design included.
- Pre-Wedding Story, from ₹20,000: a relaxed half-day somewhere that means something to the couple. 4-5 hours at up to two locations, 40+ hand-edited photographs, outfit and location guidance, a save-the-date crop set.
- Portrait, Maternity & Baby, from ₹5,000: studio or outdoor sessions. 2 hours in the studio or on location, 30+ hand-edited photographs. Props and styling are not included; referrals are available on request.
